fieldValues.title: Work is ordered by dependency
fieldValues.decision_question: In what order is dependent work built?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's walk of 2026-10-11 after session srs-programme#100; awaiting ratification.
fieldValues.decision_statement: Work is ordered by dependency: definitions first, then the checks that read them, then the interfaces built on both.
fieldValues.rationale: The rule behind the build order, stated once. The order applied to a particular body of work is a plan and is recorded elsewhere.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When a check or an interface ships before the definition it reads and has to be redone.
